progress._about: What a member keeps after a round they finished. per_visit is added to skill, power, accuracy, putting and imagination. range is added to power again when the course has a driving range. putting is added to putting again when it has a practice green. power_floor and power_cap are the length scale on the Members panel. skill_cap is the top of the other skills.

warmup._about: A one-round warm-up as a public golfer arrives. The range adds length (power). The practice green adds putting. The club pro adds accuracy. power_cap and skill_cap are where that warm-up stops. None of this is written back onto a member; what they keep is progress.
